glosses: A covering, usually a bandage, for the eyes, blocking light to the eyes.

examples.text: I put a blindfold over my boyfriend's eyes and told him I had a surprise for him.

glosses: Having the eyes covered so as to obscure vision
With the eyes covered so as to obscure vision.

examples.text: They put all the bits of cake into a bonnet. Every one, blind-fold, draws out a portion.
The commuters from the suburbs come unencumbered with luggage, children and prams, and can almost be relied upon to find their way blindfold to their trains.

glosses: Blindly; without due thought or caution.
To cover the eyes, in order to make someone unable to see.

examples.text: Children need to be blindfolded before they hit the piñata.
